verification.downloadUrls: Exact URLs observed in official Pexels download redirects. Sized download-page URLs were read from Pexels' visible quality selector.
verification.mediaFacts: Duration, resolution, frame rate, and audio-stream presence measured from downloaded MP4s using ffmpeg 7.1.
verification.visualReview: Each clip was visually inspected using a six-frame contact sheet generated from its downloaded MP4. The parent agent also approved the three selected clips.
verification.authenticity: Selected footage depicts ordinary physical people, devices, and robotics without obvious AI-generation artifacts. All three downloaded files contain 2021 creation metadata; this supports, but is not a forensic guarantee of, conventional filmed provenance.

clips.title: A Man and a Woman Looking at a Robotic Arm
clips.creator: Pavel Danilyuk
clips.downloadObservation: Official selected-size endpoint returned HTTP 200 after redirecting to this exact MP4 URL.
clips.visualNotes: A woman and older man in lab coats watch a moving articulated robotic arm. The man holds its control pendant and gestures. Restrained gray backdrop, silver arm, white clothing; studio-like lab demonstration rather than a factory production floor.

clips.title: Team Working while using Tablet and Laptop
clips.creator: Mikhail Nilov
clips.downloadObservation: Official Free download link exposed this exact MP4 redirect; direct retrieval returned HTTP 200.
clips.visualNotes: A small team works around laptops and a tablet in a bright office. People gesture toward the device and papers, with natural changes of gaze. Neutral white, charcoal, and blue palette.
